# Ayodhya Dharshan - Teerth Yatra Seva

Authorized, local tour operator providing fully-managed family pilgrimages and tour packages across Ayodhya, Varanasi (Kashi), Prayagraj, Chitrakoot, Mathura, Vrindavan, and the complete Ramayana Circuit. Highly specialized in senior citizen-friendly arrangements, premium AC transport, and fast-track VIP temple entry.

- **Primary URL**: https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/
- **Contact Phone**: +91 92352 22399 (WhatsApp 24/7)
- **Contact Email**: yatra@ayodhyadharshan.com
- **Office Address**: Near RTO Office, Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh - 224123

## Core Pilgrimage Packages

- [Ayodhya Same Day Tour](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ayodhya-same-day-tour.html): Day-long pilgrimage covering Ram Janmabhoomi, Hanuman Garhi, Kanak Bhawan, and Saryu Aarti with local AC cabs.
- [Varanasi Same Day Tour](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/varanasi-same-day-tour-package.html): Local darshan of Kashi Vishwanath, Annapurna Temple, Sarnath, and evening Ganga Aarti.
- [Ayodhya Dharshan Package (3 Days)](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ayodhya-dharshan-tour-package.html): Deep family yatra in Ayodhya covering all major ghats and historic temples.
- [Ayodhya Prayagraj Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ayodhya-prayagraj-tour-package.html): Holy journey connecting Ram Janmabhoomi and Triveni Sangam.
- [Ayodhya Varanasi Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ayodhya-varanasi-tour-package.html): Spiritual circuit connecting Kashi Vishwanath and Ayodhya Ram Mandir.
- [Ayodhya Prayagraj Varanasi Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ayodhya-prayagraj-varanasi-tour-package.html): The complete holy trinity of Uttar Pradesh yatra (Kashi, Prayag, Ayodhya).
- [5-City Holy Tour (Varanasi-Prayagraj-Chitrakoot-Ayodhya)](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ayodhya-prayagraj-chitrakoot-varanasi-tour-package.html): Extensive 6-Day pilgrimage including Kashi, Triveni Sangam, Vindhyachal, Chitrakoot, and Ayodhya.
- [Full Ramayana Circuit](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/full-ramayana-circuit-tour-package.html): All major sites of Lord Ram's journey in Uttar Pradesh.
- [Mathura Vrindavan Tour](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/mathura-vrindavan-tour-package.html): Braj Bhumi pilgrimage covering Krishna Janmabhoomi, Banke Bihari, and Prem Mandir.
- [Delhi to Ayodhya Tour Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/delhi-to-ayodhya-tour-package.html): Premium Delhi-NCR custom tour packages with flights/trains tickets assistance, hotel stays, private AC cab, and VIP Ram Mandir entry passes.
- [Mumbai to Ayodhya Tour Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/mumbai-to-ayodhya-tour-package.html): Custom Mumbai to Ayodhya packages with flights/trains tickets support, comfort hotel stays, and private cab transfers.
- [Ahmedabad to Ayodhya Tour Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ahmedabad-to-ayodhya-tour-package.html): Custom Gujarat to Ayodhya packages with direct flight booking support, stays, and VIP temple darshan entry.
- [Bengaluru to Ayodhya Tour Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/bengaluru-to-ayodhya-tour-package.html): Premium Bangalore to Ayodhya flight/train packages with local AC cab, comfort hotel stays, and English/Kannada speaking guides.
- [Hyderabad to Ayodhya Tour Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/hyderabad-to-ayodhya-tour-package.html): Custom Hyderabad to Ayodhya flight/train packages with local AC cab transfers, hotels, and English/Telugu speaking guide support.
- [Lucknow to Ayodhya Same Day Tour Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/lucknow-to-ayodhya-same-day-tour-package.html): Fast-track one-day AC cab package from Lucknow Airport or Railway Station with VIP Ram Mandir entry passes.
- [Kolkata to Ayodhya Tour Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/kolkata-to-ayodhya-tour-package.html): Custom West Bengal to Ayodhya packages with direct flight booking support, stays, and VIP temple darshan entry.
- [Chennai to Ayodhya Tour Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/chennai-to-ayodhya-tour-package.html): Premium Chennai to Ayodhya flight/train packages with local AC cab, comfort hotel stays, and English/Tamil speaking guides.
- [Patna to Ayodhya Tour Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/patna-to-ayodhya-tour-package.html): Custom Bihar to Ayodhya packages with direct road cab/train support, stays, and VIP temple darshan entry.
- [Yatra Cost Calculator](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/yatra-cost-calculator.html): Dynamic budget planner for Ayodhya, Kashi, and Prayagraj pilgrimage tours.

## Logistical Travel Guides & Blogs

- [VIP Darshan Guide](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-vip-darshan-ayodhya-ram-mandir.html): Detailed walkthrough on booking VIP entry, Sugam passes, and Aarti tickets at Ram Janmabhoomi.
- [Ayodhya to Varanasi Distance & Travel Guide](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-ayodhya-to-varanasi-distance-travel-guide.html): Train schedules, road maps, and cab fares between Kashi and Ayodhya.
- [Ayodhya Tour Cost from Delhi](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-ayodhya-tour-package-from-delhi-cost.html): Comprehensive price breakdown including trains, flights, hotels, and transport options.
- [Best Time to Visit Ayodhya](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-best-time-to-visit-ayodhya.html): Weather, festivals (Diwali, Ram Navami), and ideal months for comfortable family yatras.
- [Ayodhya Food & Sattvic Dining Guide](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-ayodhya-food-guide-sattvic-cuisine.html): Top pure vegetarian restaurants, bhojnalayas, and Sattvic food rules near Ram Mandir.
- [Lucknow to Ayodhya Transit Guide](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-lucknow-to-ayodhya-travel-guide-taxi.html): Detailed guide on taxi fares, highway road routes, and train schedules (including Vande Bharat Express) from Lucknow airport/station to Ayodhya.
- [Ayodhya Trip Cost & Budget Planner](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-ayodhya-tour-cost-budget-planner.html): Detailed cost breakdown for budget, standard, and luxury family travel in Ayodhya (Ayodhya Jane Ka Kharcha).
- [Ayodhya Varanasi Ganga Aarti Guide](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-ayodhya-varanasi-ganga-aarti-guide.html): Complete guide to river Saryu Aarti in Ayodhya and Ganga Aarti in Varanasi, including timings, boat bookings, and yatra plan.
- [Ayodhya Diwali Yatra Guide](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-ayodhya-diwali-yatra-guide.html): Complete guide to experiencing Diwali (Deepotsav) in Ayodhya, including Ram Mandir special darshan timings, Saryu Aarti, and local transit restrictions.
- [Varanasi Dev Deepawali Guide](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-varanasi-dev-deepawali-guide.html): Complete guide to Dev Deepawali in Kashi, including Kartik Poornima ghat lighting details, boat booking rules, and travel packages.
- [Ayodhya to Varanasi Taxi Fare & Cab Booking Guide](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-ayodhya-to-varanasi-taxi-fare-cab-booking.html): Fares list for Dzire, Ertiga, and Innova Crysta cabs between Ayodhya and Varanasi with highway route recommendations.
- [Ayodhya to Varanasi Vande Bharat Train Guide](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-ayodhya-to-varanasi-vande-bharat-train-guide.html): Timings, station information, CC/EC ticket prices, and booking guide for Train 22426/22425 Vande Bharat Express.
